turnout.notes: Oklahoma turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native turnout artifact is collected.

reviewCharts.warning: Oklahoma native review rows use official precinct presidential vote-share screening and same-precinct President-versus-U.S. House comparison only where the exported precinct has both Democratic and Republican U.S. House candidate votes. U.S. House District 3 and other non-comparable precincts are retained as vote-share-only rows.

historicalBaselines.warning: Oklahoma historical baseline rows come from official State Election Board county candidate exports for President race 10001. The 2016 export contains three presidential tickets and the 2020 export contains six presidential tickets (Democratic, Republican, Libertarian, and three independent tickets); all non-Democratic/non-Republican candidate votes are retained in other_votes. These are contextual jurisdictionTag flip baselines, not 2024 certified-result rows. Historical jurisdiction names use canonical Census display names while local_unit preserves official export labels; county:40079 therefore displays as Le Flore County in staging. Official 2012 county baselines remain uncollected.
